title: Telemetry ingest adapter: lightweight OTLP/Prom sampler & KPI harmonizer
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Inference request telemetry is causing high cardinality and ingestion cost for Prometheus backends and OTLP pipelines. Several high-throughput routes (chat-streaming, batch-embed) produce repetitive KV cache and prefix labels that blow up series counts. We need a lightweight ingest adapter that performs route-aware sampling, prefix-aware label normalization, and KPI harmonization (per-request latency, token_count, error_flags) before forwarding to long-term pipelines.

Goal: Implement a low-latency telemetry adapter that: 1) applies deterministic, tenant-configurable sampling for high-volume routes; 2) normalizes and reduces label cardinality using prefix rules and tag bucketing; 3) computes and emits compact per-request KPIs (p50/p95/p99 latency anchors, token cost attribution, error buckets) suitable for Prometheus/remote_write and OTel exporters; 4) preserves a 'debug' bypass path for sampled full-fidelity traces on demand.

Why: Reduces metrics cardinality and cost while keeping SLO-aligned signal fidelity. Allows Console dashboards to surface accurate KPIs without requiring full raw ingestion for every request.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter receives OTLP/Prom-style envelopes and emits normalized OTLP + remote_write-compatible metrics
Deterministic sampling reduces ingestion volume by >= 35% on simulated production traffic while preserving 95th percentile latency within +/-5% of full-fidelity baselines
Label normalization rules configurable per-tenant via feature flags and stored policy document
Per-request KPI envelope includes: request_id, model_variant, route, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, error_code_bucket
Debug path supports sampling override via request header and appears in trace logs for 1 in 1000 by default
Integration tests + benchmark harness added to repo and run in CI; PR has green performance checks
tasks: Design: finalize label bucketing rules and sampling policy (confluence: /display/OBS/Metric+Adapter+Design)
Implement: ingest adapter service with fast-path: prefix stripping, deterministic hash sampling, and KPI derivation
Add: per-tenant config API and feature-flag integration for sampling rates
Benchmark: run load tests against staging Prometheus remote_write and OTel collector; collect ingestion delta metrics
Add: e2e tests that validate metric contract and debug-bypass behavior
Docs: update Console docs for 'ingest-adapter' and add runbook for troubleshooting

2026-02-24 - Marco Gomez: Prototype adapter implemented (fast-path only). Local benchmarks show ~42% reduction in remote_write samples for simulated chat-stream workload. Observed small increase in adapter CPU but within budget.

2026-03-01 - Design review: UX requested adding a Console toggle to view 'adapter-sampled' vs 'full-fidelity' KPIs. Decision: expose a sampling metric and tag so dashboards can switch views. Recorded in design doc.
2026-03-05 - Security review note: telemetry contains request_path labels; security requested redaction of user-provided strings. Implemented prefix-based redaction and validated with SRE.

2026-03-09 - Marco Gomez: Benchmarks against staging Prometheus remote_write: ingestion bytes down 38%, series cardinality down 47% on test tenants. p95 latency for inference metric remained within +3% of baseline. Pushed PR for code review. Link: github.com/.../pull/218
